mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.user_id, e.company_id, c.name AS company_name, c.logo AS company_logo, e.type, e.title, e.difficulty, e.status, e.is_starred, e.content, e.last_reviewed_at, e.create_time, e.update_time FROM tb_entry e LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON e.company_id = c.id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.id = #{entryId} LIMIT 1

SELECT e.id, e.user_id, e.company_id, c.name AS company_name, c.logo AS company_logo, e.type, e.title, e.difficulty, e.status, e.is_starred, e.content, e.last_reviewed_at, e.create_time, e.update_time FROM tb_entry e LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON e.company_id = c.id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND (DATE_FORMAT(e.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{dateStr} OR DATE_FORMAT(e.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{dateStr}) ORDER BY e.update_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(id) AS totalEntries, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = '已掌握' THEN 1 END) AS masteredEntries, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = '学习中' THEN 1 END) AS learningEntries, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = '未掌握' THEN 1 END) AS unmasteredEntries, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_starred = 1 THEN 1 END) AS starredEntries FROM tb_entry WHERE user_id = #{userId}
